title: AgentProbe
description: An evidence-led workflow for evaluating prompt-injection resilience in authorized AI systems.
sections: Testing an AI system is only useful when findings can be reproduced, compared, and translated into a remediation decision.

Profile an authorized target, select tests, execute through an API or browser, evaluate evidence, and produce a severity-based report. A deliberately vulnerable local chatbot supports controlled demonstrations.
Keep recorded verdicts separate from AI recommendations. Mark unavailable evaluations as unknown instead of counting them as passed. Pair exact prompts and criteria when comparing runs.
Saved run history, replay, baseline comparison, cancellation and resume, YAML-defined test cases, and concise PDF reports with evidence references.
Designed for explicitly authorized systems. Browser login is completed manually; the framework does not request account passwords or bypass verification.
The supplied project documentation describes the implemented workflow. No adoption or effectiveness metric is claimed here.
